newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST-Elkem Q1 profits seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Elkem Q1 profits seen down.

text.p: Norwegian metals maker Elkem ASA is expected to post first-quarter profits of 223 million crowns, down from 312 million in the same period last year, according to a consensus forecast among nine analysts polled by Reuters.
Two analysts recommended buying the share, four said hold and one said sell. The remaining two made no recommendation.
The most negative analysts expected the price of ferrosilicon to fall and that the difference to manganese alloys thus would shrink.
"The share is not particularily expensive but the second quarter will not be as good as the first, and the third will be even worse," the analyst who recommended to sell the share said.
Analysts earlier saw the strong Norwegian crown as a major problem for export-oriented Elkem this year, but now that the currency has depreciated considerably most had a more optimistic outlook.
The normalisation of electricity supplies was seen as another factor for an upgrading of EPS forecasts.
Elkem will present its first-quarter results on Monday.
